capabilities: Sync the vault with a Filen folder in both-way, vault-to-Filen, or Filen-to-vault modes
Trigger syncs automatically after idle typing, on an interval, or at startup
Resolve conflicts by saving the other version as a note.conflict file instead of overwriting
Sync the .obsidian folder's plugins and themes across devices, excluding workspace.json
Run a force sync from an empty snapshot to reconcile drifted devices without deleting anything
extras: Not yet in the community plugin list; installs via BRAT or manually. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later for the declarative settings API. Files are held in memory during transfer, so large attachments should be excluded or size-capped. Credentials are stored in Obsidian's secret storage, not in the vault.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep a vault synchronized across devices using a Filen account, so users must rely on manual copies or other sync services.

relations.evidence: Sync your vault with Filen end-to-end encrypted cloud storage
Talks to Filen directly through the official SDK, so there is no server to run

summary: Syncs an Obsidian vault with Filen end-to-end encrypted cloud storage, with bidirectional or one-way modes and automatic triggers.
